front-door: Battery video doorbell mounted beside the front door at chest height, looking out over the small front garden. The front door itself is just past the RIGHT edge of the frame: someone who walks up and leaves the frame on the right has gone in through the front door, and someone who appears from the right edge has come out of the house. A hedge runs across the middle; the path leads left towards the street and a parking space at the left edge where a light blue VW is usually parked. At night the image is greyscale infrared; a sudden switch to colour means a porch or hall light came on.
driveway: Camera on an upstairs front window looking down over the front of the house. The LEFT part of the frame is window glass, curtain and houseplants; ignore reflections there. The tiled porch roof is along the bottom and the front door is under it, out of view. The front path runs from the porch along the hedge up to the cul-de-sac road at the top. People on the road at the top are usually passers-by or neighbours.
garden: Camera on an upstairs rear window looking down. Left: the back garden (lawn, shed, patio, back door below the camera). Right: the rear parking area where the household parks its cars. A wooden gate in the fence joins the parking area to the garden; people coming from the cars through the gate are usually residents coming home the back way. The white window frame fills the bottom right.
